name: com.ninjadini.neuro-unity
description: A unified, data-driven toolset for Unity. At its core a fast, compact, allocation-free C# binary and JSON serializer with no schema files and no reflection at runtime — backwards and forwards compatible, inspired by Protocol Buffers. Ships with editor tooling to author, validate, debug and ship your config data, and to save player progress.

samples.description: A small crafting game exercising most of Neuro: Referencable config types, Reference<T> links, inheritance, content validators and player progress saving. Importing this copies NeuroCraftClicker.unitypackage into your project - double-click it to import the demo.
